title: Survive The Reset - Another voxel survival!
author: Regular-Dingo-2872
selftext:
Almost finished 1 more week to get the story down!! Vibe coded using Astra and Opus switching between the 2. [https://thisisdemo.itch.io/survive-the-reset](https://thisisdemo.itch.io/survive-the-reset)

comments.author: waypostmaster
comments.body:
Do they complain when they come back to their codebase and see the other model stepped all over it?

My kid would love this. Like piloting an upgraded ender dragon.

replies.author: Regular-Dingo-2872
replies.body: Haha they actually do! But in a very diplomatic way. They say "this code looks broken, but its not mine".  I should make the dragon early game. Currently you have to do a few missions before dragon

replies.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
replies.body:
That's just what they say even if it is theirs lol.  I have a very strict rule that tests must NEVER reference shipping content. Every once in a while an old one from before the rule surfaces when I'm making other changes.  Claude will happily and confidently say "Just to note: One of the tests that broke references shipping content, that's a hard failure but it's not mine."

Sir, you wrote it 2 months ago.

For what it's worth it was a rule I made to avoid tests breaking every time I changed live content, because that was happening at one point, now it's largely fixed enough that I don't particularly care if there's a few stragglers that havent popped up yet.

replies.author: Regular-Dingo-2872
replies.body: Classic haha, thanks yep its a good idea cheers.  Ill have to start that

replies.author: Outrageous-Issue9722
replies.body: It was bad haha. It was treating every proof of concept/stat adjustment as gospel. Like writing tests pinning that a placeholder goblin existed at region 4,1 on plane 0 at tile 62,40 and it had exactly 22hp and had a chance to drop a specific item when it died.
